import sys

def run():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:1+n]))
    a.sort()
    t = int(input[1+n])
    i = -1
    j = 0
    mx = 0
    while j != n:
        i += 1
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        mx = max(mx, j - i)
    print(mx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
